item.title: Q & A: What Constitutes Sheimot (Part II)
item.description: Question: I am the gabbai in a large synagogue, where many people bring Divrei Torah handouts to distribute. item.title: Dear Dr. Yael
item.description: Getting drunk on Shabbos is not a mitzvah, not a minhag, and not harmless. While drinking a l’chaim has a place in Jewish life, drinking until one is intoxicated, especially when it interferes with davening, parenting, and basic derech eretz, undermines the very kedusha Shabbos is meant to bring.
